rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things belonging to the present age rather than ancient times.

example.english: This film is about modern people's lives.
example.traditional: 呢套戲講現代人嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 jin6 doi6 jan4 ge3 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this for a modern or up-to-date design, method, product, or facility, especially in contrast with an old-fashioned one.

example.english: This is a modern washing machine that saves a lot of water.
example.traditional: 呢部係新式洗衣機，慳水好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 hai6 san1 sik1 sai2 ji1 gei1 haan1 seoi2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when “modern” emphasizes being contemporary and fashionable in style.

example.english: They dress so modern that they become the centre of attention as soon as they walk in.
example.traditional: 佢着到咁新潮，行入去即刻成為焦點。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 gam3 san1 ciu4 haang4 jap6 heoi3 zik1 hak1 sing4 wai4 ziu1 dim2
